narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='c1'/>Next comes eigh minus b, times eigh to the power four plus b to the power four.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>Expand it. Eigh times the bracket gives eigh to the power five plus eigh b to the power four.
<bookmark mark='c3'/>Minus b times it gives minus eigh to the power four b, minus b to the power five.
<bookmark mark='c4'/>Nothing cancels, so his guess fails. The long bracket needs every middle term.

narration: <bookmark mark='k1'/>To check, put eigh as two and b as one.
<bookmark mark='k2'/>Two to the power five, take away one, is thirty one.
<bookmark mark='k3'/>The bracket gives sixteen plus eight plus four plus two plus one, also thirty one.
<bookmark mark='k4'/>Both sides match, so the pattern holds.
